question.knowledge_point: Finding the Reduced Row Echelon Form of a Singular 3x3 System With One Pivot
question.problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-x-y-3z=1 \\ 2x+2y+6z=-2 \\ -2x-2y-6z=2\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -1 & -3 & 1 \\ 2 & 2 & 6 & -2 \\ -2 & -2 & -6 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & -1 & -3 & 1 \\ 2 & 2 & 6 & -2 \\ -2 & -2 & -6 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 2 & 2 & 6 & -2 \\ -2 & -2 & -6 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & -2 & -6 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

judgment.reasoning: All six final answers agree with their own captured worked solutions. Source errors occur in intermediate explanations. q-142915: P(Y=4)=0.25, so dividing the Y=4 column by 0.25 gives probabilities 0.4, 0.6, 0; the source incorrectly writes P(Y=1) as a denominator, although its subsequent calculations and final table are correct. q-142928: P(X=0)=0.5, so dividing the X=0 row by 0.5 gives 0.4, 0.2, 0.4 at y=0,2,4. The source incorrectly names f_{X|Y} in its opening prose, labels the other row X=1 instead of X=2, and reverses the conditioning in the displayed calculation labels. Its numerical calculations actually compute P(Y=y|X=0), and its final table is correct. q-74536: negate the first row, then subtract twice that row from the second and add twice it to the third; both become zero. q-74604: R3-5R1 followed by R3-8R2 gives z=-6; eliminating z and y above their pivots gives y=13 and x=40. q-10662: R3-2R1 followed by R3+R2 produces [0,0,0,-3], proving inconsistency. q-73958: R2+2R1 followed by R3+R2 produces [0,0,0,34], also proving inconsistency. Its corresponding-system transcription incorrectly says x-2y-6z=8; the correct equation is x+2y-6z=8. This does not alter the no-solution conclusion. The four previously reviewed linear-system answers remain unchanged. No submission grades were supplied; all MA answer evidence comes from captured worked solutions.
